balderton-capital._readme: Durable identity corrections consumed by build-company-base.py on every rebuild (COLLECTION.md s8): one company rendered under different names across Balderton's surfaces (the 2026 list, the benchmark.com Europe desk pages 2001-2009, Form D issuer names) and its renames. Canonical = the firm's current rendering where the company is still listed. Written during the grind (PRO-106, 2026-09-26) and applied at the one scheduled rebuild.

merges.name: DisplayLink
merges.reason: one company: Newnham Research (Cambridge) was renamed DisplayLink in 2006; the 2005-06 benchmark.com list carries the old name, the 2007-08 list and the live card the new one

merges.name: WeeWorld
merges.reason: one company: the 2005-06 benchmark.com entry 'Saw-You' links to weeworld.com; Saw-You.com was renamed WeeWorld in 2006

merges.name: Lovefilm
merges.reason: one investment: the desk backed Video Island (Coelho director of Video Island Entertainment 2004-07), which merged into Lovefilm in 2006; the desk page lists Video Island 2004-06 and Lovefilm International from 2007

merges.name: Workhuman
merges.reason: one company: Globoforce was renamed Workhuman in 2019; the benchmark.com lists carry the old name, the live card the new one

merges.name: Hubs
merges.reason: one company: 3D Hubs, Inc. is the Form D issuer name of the company the live card calls Hubs (renamed 2021)

merges.name: Voize
merges.reason: one company: anyvoice Inc. is the Form D issuer of the $50M round of 2025-Q4 (Waterhouse director), the Series A the firm announced for voize on 2025-11-17

merges.name: Simple Feast
merges.reason: one company: Feast Kitchen Inc. (San Francisco) filed the Form Ds of 2019-Q4 ($21M) and 2021-Q1 with Waterhouse as director, the US entity of Simple Feast, whose $33M Series B the firm announced on 2019-09-18; medium confidence, flagged in report.md

merges.name: GoCardless
merges.reason: one company: GoCardless was founded as GroupPay; Groupay, Inc. (London) files its Form Ds with Bunting as director (GoCardless director 2014-23), and the 2022-Q2 filing of $321.6M is the round the firm announced on 2022-02-08

merges.name: LevelUp
merges.reason: one company: SCVNGR, Inc. renamed itself LevelUp; Maloney signs its Form Ds 2011-17 and the live card is LevelUp
